sections.overview: This small marine fish is known from Japanese waters, including the Izu region and nearby seas.
sections.identification: It has an elongated body and high anterior dorsal-fin rays.
sections.habitat: It lives on sandy seabeds around 30 m deep.
sections.diet: Its diet is not detailed in the sources consulted.
sections.behavior: When threatened, it can hide in the sand.
sections.reproduction: Reproduction is not described in the sources consulted.
sections.ecology: A Smithsonian study describes it as a rare Japanese bottom-dweller and examines its skeletal anatomy.
sections.conservation: No conservation assessment was found in the consulted sources.
